defs.def: a style of dancing that tells a dramatic story with music but no talking or singing 芭蕾舞

ex.s: I enjoyed it so much that it’s changed my opinion about ballet.
ex.t: 我太喜欢了，以至于它改变了我对芭蕾舞的看法。

defs.def: a story or work of art performed by a group of ballet dancers 芭蕾舞剧

ex.s: I went to watch the ballet The Peony Pavilion last night.
ex.t: 昨晚我去看了芭蕾舞剧《牡丹亭》。

ex.s: Because I thought ballet was more or less the same everywhere, I was totally unprepared for its unique beauty.
ex.t: 因为我原以为芭蕾舞无论在哪里都大同小异，所以对它独特的美毫无准备。

ex.s: The performance borrowed a lot from Chinese dance and music, so the Eastern influence on the ballet was clear.
ex.t: 这部作品大量借鉴了中国舞蹈和音乐，因此东方对这部芭蕾舞剧的影响清晰可见。

ex.s: Ballet Club Nature Club Volunteer Club Debate Club 2 Listen to the first two conversations and choose the correct answers.
ex.t: 芭蕾俱乐部　自然俱乐部　志愿者俱乐部　辩论俱乐部　2 听前两段对话并选择正确答案。

defs.def: a group of dancers who work and perform ballet together 芭蕾舞团

chunks.cn: 观看芭蕾舞剧 / 芭蕾舞剧
